records.statement: KTM's 2020 manual sets the 250 SX air fork at 10.1 bar (146 psi) on EU bikes and 10.2 bar (148 psi) on US bikes for a 75-85 kg rider, with a shock spring of 39 N/mm (65-75 kg), 42 N/mm (75-85 kg) or 45 N/mm (85-95 kg) and 35 mm static / 105 mm riding sag.

records.statement: KTM's 2020 XC-W TPI manual uses a progressive linkless shock spring chosen by rider weight: 57-63 N/mm for 65-75 kg, 60-66 N/mm for 75-85 kg and 63-69 N/mm for 85-95 kg, with 37 mm static and 110 mm riding sag. Fork and shock clickers are 18/15/12 (comfort/standard/sport).
